text.en:
On Weapon Kill:
Grants #e${8 + #d}% Ability Energy split equally amongst all uncharged abilities.

<blue If you have more than 3 ability charges in total, the perk stops functioning. />

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Total Ability Energy gain is increased by 1%.
)
text.zh-chs:
使用武器击杀时：
获取 #e${8 + #d}% 的技能能量，平均分配到所有未充能的技能中。

<blue 如果你有 3 个以上技能充能完毕， 该 perk 将不会生效。 />

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e 额外获取 1% 的技能能量。
)

On Weapon Kill:
Grants #e${8*#d}% Ability Energy split equally amongst all uncharged abilities.

Abilities with multiple charges only receive a smaller portion of the ability energy granted once they have a full ability charge ready.

#e Ability Energy Gain is increased by 12.5%.
